bootstrap.F_cross_host: Fetch owner branches on current host; use explicit real worktree with correct origin+owner branch. Historical174 reference path is not remote filesystem proof.

consumption.active_native_protection: No interruption/restart or in-flight source/registry change for message intake
consumption.bounded_checks: Only new indexed event metadata and exact referenced small artifacts, bounded by configured limits; no raw/trace scan
consumption.out_of_order: Return unseen lower-sequence events in late_unseen; do not consume them, mark them seen or change their sender cursor. Retain them for explicit reconciliation.
consumption.pending_consumer: No ACK means UNACKNOWLEDGED, not failure, execution or scientific approval
consumption.stale_presence: A declared status is not a process/lease heartbeat; report last observed time, never infer remote process state
triggers: At start/resume of existing lane turn
After meaningful artifact publication or accepted-result delivery
Before dependent work or next safe execution boundary
consumption.unchanged_state: No repeat event or status rewrite solely to claim no change; keep current task moving

event_fields.body: bounded human-readable data; never executable command authority
event_fields.correlation_id: optional <=240 character cross-channel conversation identifier; no execution authority
event_fields.event_id: owner-prefixed unique immutable ID, safe filename
event_fields.recipients: nonempty distinct active lane IDs, explicit fanout
event_fields.refs: array of exact immutable Git blob references; no local absolute path can stand in for cross-host reference
event_fields.sequence: positive strictly increasing owner sequence; no reuse
event_fields.subject: short change-oriented summary
event_fields.work_key: optional <=240 character stable scientific-work/delivery key across old/new channels; does not merge conflicting terminal evidence

event_kind_requirements.ACK: ack_for and ack_status required; source_commit cannot be blank; author must be original recipient; VALIDATED/APPLIED require explicit --confirm-reference-review owner attestation, never scientific acceptance
event_kind_requirements.DELIVERY: At least one immutable trusted Git reference; scientific status can only be claimed by pointing to E accepted artifacts
event_kind_requirements.REQUEST: No execution or contract authority; refs may be empty for an initial coordination request
event_kind_requirements.STATUS: Own lane activity only; refs may be empty

A2.role: Producer/source/runtime/native evidence; no E acceptance authority

B.role: Victim/reuse evidence and candidate input semantics

D.role: Incremental scientific analysis, figures and manuscript evidence

E2.role: Sole formal application acceptance/execution owner; temporary collaboration protocol owner

local_mailbox_scope: Same physical original174 filesystem only; never presumed visible to remote F or any other host

reference_fields.role: producer_release / accepted_pair / endpoint_receipt / analysis / request_context / other declared role
reference_fields.sha256: 64hex SHA256 of exact Git blob bytes

reference_validation.ACK_RECEIVED: Only exact published event receipt; no artifact validation implied
reference_validation.recipient: Before VALIDATED/APPLIED, actual owner reviews referenced artifacts using existing scientific readers or bounded Git blob checks and explicitly confirms reference review; this attestation is not scientific acceptance
reference_validation.transport: check/import-event FORMAT_ONLY_NOT_CONTENT_VERIFIED; source event independently verified by actual owner remote branch/commit/SHA
reference_validation.validated_applied: Explicit owner review confirmation plus exact regular Git blob SHA verification limited to same-Framework docs/ep_l2 allowlisted text metadata, <=16MiB total; APPLIED requires published output ref; never scientific acceptance

science_rules.A2_release: A2 producer artifact can be a dependency but never substitutes E independent qualification
science_rules.D_ack: Analysis intake/consumption only; cannot convert incomplete/failed/HOLD to accepted
science_rules.accepted_results_authority: Existing E CURRENT_ACCEPTED pair/endpoint artifacts and original ledger; transport event is only a pointer
science_rules.authority_reference_rule: Discovery links are mutable pointers only; every scientific delivery must pin actual E accepted artifact commit/path/SHA. This transport contract does not specify or reset startup limits, time limits, quotas, result accounting or T0.

transport.authoritative_cross_branch_host: Published Git commit+blob+SHA, fetched and read with git show without checkout/merge/reset
transport.remote_visibility_before_ack: Consumer independently reads source commit/blob and validates SHA; recipient signs only own ACK event
transport.same_host_fast_path: Local immutable mailbox delivery with origin event bytes; unpublished refs explicitly preview-only

writer_rules.authentication_scope: Branch/root checks prevent accidental cross-lane writes under the shared Linux account; they are not cryptographic agent authentication.
writer_rules.duplicate_conflicting: Reject/retain conflict evidence; do not overwrite either origin
writer_rules.duplicate_identical: No-op plus existing ID; do not repeat downstream work
writer_rules.imported_bytes: Byte-identical local cache is transport evidence, not origin publication or ACK
writer_rules.origin_events: Only owner in its registered branch/worktree publishes original event; immutable O_EXCL/no overwrite
writer_rules.sequence_collision: Reject conflict; one active writer per lane across hosts; no forced push
writer_rules.status_cursor: Only own lane updates own status/cursor atomically under per-owner transport lock
writer_rules.transport_lock: Local per-owner mailbox lock only; never a resource/controller lock
writer_rules.worktree_validation: All lanes: actual cwd must equal canonical git worktree root; verify exact registered branch and normalized origin repository. Configured absolute paths are host references/defaults, not cross-host existence claims; F requires explicit current-host --worktree.
